UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'pocketmine-mp'; Write-Output 'Removing old server files'; @('PocketMine-MP.phar', './bin') | ForEach-Object { if (Test-Path \"$_\") { Remove-Item -Path \"$_\" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null } }"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $PHPVersion='{{PHPVersion}}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($PHPVersion)) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ((Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/pmmp/PHP-Binaries/releases/latest').assets | Where-Object { $_.browser_download_url -match '.*/PHP.*Windows-x64.*\.zip$' })[0].browser_download_url -OutFile 'PHP.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"Latest PHP Binary release version downloaded\"; } } elseif ($PHPVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid PHP Binary version format specified\"; exit 1; } else { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ((Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/pmmp/PHP-Binaries/releases/tags/$PHPVersion").assets | Where-Object { $_.browser_download_url -match '.*/PHP.*Windows-x64.*\.zip$' })[0].browser_download_url -OutFile 'PHP.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"PHP Binary release version $PHPVersion downloaded\"; } }"

-c "cd pocketmine-mp && V=\"{{PMMPVersion}}\" && if [[ -z \"$V\" ]]; then B=latest/download; elif [[ \"$V\" =~ ^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+$ ]]; then B=download/$V; else echo \"Invalid PocketMine-MP version format specified\" && exit 1; fi && B=https://github.com/pmmp/PocketMine-MP/releases/$B && wget -qO build_info.json $B/build_info.json && PHP=$(jq -r .php_version build_info.json) && PM=$(jq -r .base_version build_info.json) && wget -qO PocketMine-MP.phar $B/PocketMine-MP.phar && rm -rf bin && wget -qO- https://github.com/pmmp/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/pm${PM%%.*}-php-$PHP-latest/PHP-$PHP-Linux-x86_64-PM${PM%%.*}.tar.gz | tar -zx && E=$(find $PWD/bin -name '*debug-zts*') && sed -i \"1i extension_dir=$E\" bin/php7/bin/php.ini && echo \"PocketMine-MP $PM installed with PHP $PHP\""
